source_metadata.title: Comparative Outcomes of Empagliflozin to Dapagliflozin in Patients With Heart Failure

findings: No duplicate atoms were retained after semantic review.

Internal source inconsistency: abstract/flow text reports 11,077 matched patients per group, while the body results, baseline table, Figure 2 risk table, and supplement subgroup structure use 11,007 for the main matched cohort. Quantitative atoms use 11,007 per group and retain a discrepancy tag.
The article notes a July 24, 2024 correction for a numerical error, but the retrieved corrected PDF still contains the 11,077 versus 11,007 matched-sample inconsistency.

extraction_limitations: Supplement 2 (Data Sharing Statement) is referenced in the article but was not present in the retrieved Google Drive folder.
TriNetX source data are not available in the retrieved source set; atom validation confirms source reporting, not independent reproducibility.
The atom schema has no dedicated field for E-values; the E-value is preserved in the canonical statement/original result text rather than a normalized quantitative field.
The atom schema has no dedicated corrected-publication/version field; the correction notice is represented as an other atom and source metadata.
schema_gaps: No native field for observational sensitivity metrics such as E-values.
No native field for publication correction/version state.
No direct representation of multiple source anchors on one atom; the matched-sample discrepancy is therefore documented in validation rather than encoded as a multi-anchor atom.
